title: Erdős Problem #1169: Partition Relations for ω₁²

overview.historicalContext:
Erdős Problem #1169 concerns partition relations for ω₁². This problem remains OPEN.

Known results include: - Hajnal proved the partition relation holds assuming the Continuum Hypothesis (CH). - The problem is "not disprovable" — there exist models of set theory where it holds. - The general ZFC status remains open. - Problem #592: For which countable β does ω^β → (ω^β, 3)² hold?

This problem is catalogued at erdosproblems.com/1169.
